scripts.data:baseline: PYTHONPATH=python .venv/bin/python scripts/generate-expert-dataset.py --split train --out data/behavior-cloning-v1/train.parquet --metrics runs/baseline-v1/train-dataset.metrics.json && PYTHONPATH=python .venv/bin/python scripts/generate-expert-dataset.py --split validation --out data/behavior-cloning-v1/validation.parquet --metrics runs/baseline-v1/validation-dataset.metrics.json
